label: Slack: Send Message
description: Post a message through the connected workspace's bot: to a channel or as a direct message to a user, plain text and/or Block Kit blocks, optionally as a thread reply or scheduled for later. Emits the posted message's ts, channel, and permalink (or the scheduled id when scheduling).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the chat:write scope; sending to a user also needs im:write.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: Pick a channel or paste its id
inputs.description: The destination channel. Leave empty when sending a direct message via the user input (exactly one of the two).

inputs.name: user
inputs.label: Direct message user
inputs.placeholder: Pick a user or paste their id (U...)
inputs.description: Send as a direct message to this user instead of into a channel (exactly one of the two).

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The message text. With blocks present, this is the notification fallback text.

inputs.name: blocks
inputs.label: Blocks
inputs.description: Block Kit blocks (the JSON array from Slack's Block Kit Builder) for rich layout. Text and/or blocks must be provided.

inputs.name: threadTs
inputs.label: Reply in thread
inputs.description: Post as a reply inside this message's thread instead of top-level.

inputs.name: postAt
inputs.label: Schedule (epoch seconds)
inputs.description: Schedule the message for this Unix time (up to 120 days ahead) instead of posting now. A scheduled message emits scheduledId instead of ts/permalink.

outputs.name: ts
outputs.description: The posted message's timestamp id (empty when scheduled).

outputs.name: channel
outputs.description: The channel the message landed in (the DM conversation id for user sends).

outputs.name: permalink
outputs.description: A link to the posted message (empty when scheduled).

outputs.name: scheduledId
outputs.description: The scheduled message's id when postAt was set.
